items.title: ‘This can’t keep happening’: How divorced military spouses get trapped in foreign countries
items.brief: Christina Fuller is an American former military spouse living without legal residency in southern Spain, where a custody fight has kept her and her son for years.

items.title: Pope Leo makes history by voting in US midterms
items.brief: Pope Leo XIV has submitted a mail-in ballot for the US midterms, becoming the first pope to vote in a US election and likely the first to vote in a secular democratic election.

items.title: Wall Street sell-off deepens as investors question returns on ‘monster AI splurge’
items.brief: Wall Street suffered a steep day of losses Friday after the latest tech earnings reignited concerns that massive spending on AI may not deliver the returns that investors expect.

items.title: Major anti-government protests sweep across Italy
items.brief: Farmers dumped manure on the streets of Turin on Friday as mass demonstrations unfurled across more than 50 cities in Italy.

items.title: What is happening in Oleshky, the occupied Ukrainian town at the center of a Melania Trump ceasefire?
items.brief: Hundreds of people from an occupied town in southern Ukraine who survived months without basic supplies are being evacuated on Friday under a ceasefire agreement negotiated by first lady Melania Trump .
